title: Accountant reads stock, supplier bills, goods receipts and inbound review but writes none of them: narrow the 24 M16/M4/M3 writes in permissions.ts and in the services' role checks
rootCause:
CONFIRMED (re-traced by the reviewer). There is one cause. The server enforces it at two layers, and the app follows the first layer by design.

Why it exists. The founder narrowed the accountant on 2026-09-05:
- docs/22-source-of-truth.md:248: 'money desk + reads: may record office receipts, deposits, cheque bounces, write-offs; reads and exports everything'.
- docs/23-app-screens-and-api-gaps.md:205: 'the accountant sees M1-M2, M9-M15, M21 and everything else read-only'.
- docs/23 §8.20 at :896-899.
The enforcement moved only prices, schemes, credit, approvals, catalog and settings to MANAGEMENT (backend/libs/contracts/src/permissions.ts:142-150). Stock (M16), supplier bills, goods receipts and POs (M4), and inbound review (M3) stayed on groups that include the accountant. The docint rows were given to her on purpose, from the brief-era assumption 'the CA reviews inbound invoices' (docs/plans/docint.md:239). The same assumption is repeated at permissions.ts:699-700 and backend/libs/contracts/src/docint.ts:30-34.

Layer 1, the matrix (backend/libs/contracts/src/permissions.ts).
- BACK_OFFICE_OR_WAREHOUSE (:76-81) includes the accountant and guards four rows: inventory.locations.upsert :477, inventory.stock.adjust :480, inventory.stock.transfer :481, inventory.lots.upsert :483.
- BACK_OFFICE (:42) guards the other twenty:
  - inventory.cycleCounts.post :488
  - procurement.supplierInvoices.create :494, matchLine :497, dispute :498, cancel :499
  - procurement.grns.open :502, procurement.grns.post :504
  - procurement.purchaseOrders.upsert :511
  - docint.documents.reject :714, docint.documents.approve :715
  - docint.extractions.run :716
  - docint.matches.accept/reject/choose/rerun :720-723
  - docint.review.start/heartbeat/save/release/submit :724-728
- That makes 24 procedures (5 inventory, 7 procurement, 12 docint). The original plan said 23.
- Live proof: GET :3002/docs/openapi.json, fetched 2026-09-13, lists 'accountant' in x-roles on exactly these 24 POST routes.

Layer 2, the guard. backend/libs/core/src/modules/tenancy/tenant.guard.ts:178-179 refuses only a role the row leaves out, so the accountant's token passes.

Layer 3, the module role checks. They mirror the same groups, so they accept an accountant on their own; narrowing only the matrix would leave the module layer open. Each site calls requireRole with a list that includes the accountant:
- backend/libs/core/src/modules/inventory/stock.service.ts:89 `STOCK_WRITERS = [...BACK_OFFICE, 'warehouse']` (BACK_OFFICE is platform/authz.ts:5). Used at upsertLocation :132, adjust :248, transfer :272, upsertLot :345.
- inventory/cycle-counts.service.ts:207: post uses BACK_OFFICE.
- procurement/supplier-invoice.service.ts uses BACK_OFFICE at create :116, createInTx :131, matchLine :337, upsertPurchaseOrder :419, dispute :496, cancel :526.
- procurement/grn.service.ts uses BACK_OFFICE at open :128 and post :305.
- docint/docint.internals.ts:30 sets `DESK = BACK_OFFICE` for reads and writes alike. Writes: documents.service.ts reject :496, approve :532; extractions.service.ts run :57; matches.service.ts accept :98, reject :147, choose :205, rerun :273; review.service.ts start :85, heartbeat :155, save :172, release :215, submit :260.

Layer 4, the app. This is intended behaviour, not a second defect: the app draws what the matrix allows.
- frontend/manager-app/src/lib/ui.tsx:600 `useCan` = isAllowed(permissionFor(path), role).
- stock/index.tsx:68 `mayAdjust` gates row selection (:249-257). Selecting a row opens the Adjust dialog, which holds 'Move stock' (:352-361).
- inbound/index.tsx:107 `mayWrite = can('procurement.grns.open')` gates open, dispute and post (:435, :512).
- inbound/documents.tsx:101-102 `mayReview`/`mayApprove` gate every write button (:451, :473-556). Otherwise the panel shows app.accountantRead (:560; strings.ts:81).
- Nav tabs are gated on reads (src/nav.ts:34, :38, :76-78), so the accountant keeps every screen.

No other write path reaches these tables for the accountant:
- Sync: the inventory module registers pulls only (inventory.module.ts:40-42), and docint.sync.ts carries gate capture, which stays.
- Worker: the docint jobs run as 'system'.
- Internal callers: grns.open/post, supplierInvoices matchLine/dispute/cancel/upsertPurchaseOrder and stock adjust/transfer/upsertLot/upsertLocation are reached only from their controllers. createInTx is called only from docint approve (documents.service.ts:627).
- RLS is wider on purpose (stock_ledger staffWritePolicy; docint tables BACK_OFFICE_ROLES), as for every other MANAGEMENT narrowing (permissions.ts:9-10).

Data proof (dos_qa, SELECT): stock_ledger 01a094d5-d5ca-70b5-82f5-7b5081fcd9e0 has reason damage, qty -1, actor meena.joshi (membership role accountant), note 'QA accountant permission probe', 2026-09-12 14:27:17 IST.
